name: National Commander's Unit Citation Award (miniature medal body)
size_basis: estimated: the body measured in the Vanguard product photograph against the suspension ribbon's width, 176 px taken as 0.6875 in (the miniature suspension ribbon, 11/16 in, CAPR 39-1 11.3 as compose.js MINI_DRAPE): body 0.707 x 0.7148 in in the photograph. Height follows the body's own aspect. The width is the existing CAP asset's (0.625 in, assets/medals, kept as the brief asks; the photo measures 0.707 in). The drawing keeps the width and the box; it is built from the photograph's own measured proportions (body width 183.6 px = 0.625 in).
ribbon_attach_note: ribbon_attach is the top centre of the suspension ring (or of the bail where the box cuts the ring away), on the body axis: the body is upright, the photograph's hang angle (-2.5 deg) is removed; compose.js hangs it at the drape's V point

dimensions.ribbon_note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices (ribbon_ref as the previous asset)

match_note: CAP body: the existing asset id and width of assets/medals/medal-national-commander-unit-citation-award-miniature; ribbon_ref as that asset

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is the top of the suspension ring.

frame.note: body width 0.625 in (the spec width); every length below is inches in the medal frame (origin = body centre, +y down, upright)

measured.hang_angle_note: angle (clockwise, degrees) at which the photographed medal hangs, from the bail axis; measured, removed: the shipped body is upright and ribbon_attach is the top centre of the ring (or of the bail where the box cuts the ring)

lettering.letter_positions: angle and radial extent of each letter, measured from the unwrapped annulus (generator, text.top / text.bottom)

gates.silhouette_iou: >= 0.95 (shipped upright miniature vs the photograph mask resampled into the same upright box)
gates.landmarks: every named feature centroid within 0.02 in of the reference
gates.edge_recall: lit-metal outline recall >= 0.80 within 0.012 in (0.006 in reported)
gates.ink_coverage: lit-metal area of mine / reference between 0.85 and 1.15 (body and named zones): letters and emblem strokes as solid as the reference
gates.ribbon_attach: top centre of the ring (or of the bail where the box cuts the ring) at the box top, x on the body axis

not_measurable: the eagle (lib-b-eagle.js blades; head turned left, wings mirror-symmetric about u = 0): head profile with hooked beak and eye, curved arm bar per wing, a row of 8 primary blades (tip, root and width read off the left wing: the ladder of long feathers is resolved in the photograph), a covert row of 5 shorter blades, a 5-blade tail fan, 3 toes per foot and a bar of six pills. The right wing is the mirror of the left (the photograph shows the same rows); the covert and shoulder blades (the last three of the covert row) and the tail-fan count are approximate: the 600 px photograph (one pixel = 0.0034 in) does not separate them

the chest is drawn as 5 rows of overlapping scale blades (13 in all): the photograph shows breast feathers but not their count or positions; the talons are drawn as 3 toes per foot placed under the tail, not counted

the sunburst is drawn regular and symmetric: 4 upper rays per side at a pitch of 11 deg (37, 48, 59, 70 deg from straight up about the star-ring centre, measured peaks 35.5-38.5, 47-49.5, 58.5-60, 70-70.5), each with a shorter second line 3.2 deg inside, and 3 lower rays per side (117.5, 129, 140.5 deg); the photograph shows more, finer lines between them that are not measurable

the lettering is a skeleton-font alphabet with a serifed I and a stroked apostrophe placed letter by letter (angle and width fitted to the photograph); the engraved face has slab-like ends the font does not draw
the photograph is dark and low in contrast on the right and lower right of the lettering ring, so letter positions there are fitted (IoU 0.5 to 0.7) rather than read off
fidelity.note: Redrawn as clean parametric vector (LIVE13-ART 26, batch B): every element is modelled as the object it is (letters, stars, wreath leaves, banner, aircraft ...) with its proportions measured from the photograph and placed by measurement; flat tones with a lit and a shadow edge; upright. Replaces the traced body (LIVE13-ART 20).

fit_score.note: IoU of the shipped upright miniature against the photograph mask in the same box (lib-b.js)

notes: Designed miniature medal body (LIVE13-ART 26, batch B), upright. Measured from national-commander-unit-citation.jpeg (reference only, never shipped). Hang angle -2.5 deg of the photograph removed.
